description_en: Queries push statistics for a message
description_zh: 查询消息维度的推送统计
name: QueryPushStatByMsg

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the pushed message. This ID is returned after a message is pushed.

Push data is available the next day. You cannot query data for the current day
parameters.help_zh:
推送的消息ID，推送之后会返回该ID。
推送数据隔天展示，不支持查询今日数据
parameters.name: message_id

PushStat.description_en: An array of PushStat objects. Each object contains the push statistics for a message or notification
PushStat.description_zh: 消息/通知的推送结果统计PushStat组成的数组

AcceptCount.description_en: The number of pushes accepted by the push server
AcceptCount.description_zh: 推送服务端接收到的推送数目

DeletedCount.description_en: The number of times the notification was cleared on devices
DeletedCount.description_zh: 通知在设备上被清除的数目

OpenedCount.description_en: The number of times the notification was opened on devices
OpenedCount.description_zh: 通知在设备上被点击的数目

ReceivedCount.description_en: The number of messages delivered to devices
ReceivedCount.description_zh: 实际送达到设备的数目

SentCount.description_en: The number of messages sent from the push server
SentCount.description_zh: 推送服务端实际发出的数目

SmsFailedCount.description_en: (Optional) The number of text messages that failed to send in a composite push. This can happen if the service is not activated, authorization is denied, or parameters are invalid
SmsFailedCount.description_zh: （可为空）短信复合推送短信发送失败的数目，例如未开通对应服务、未授权通过、参数错误等

SmsReceiveFailedCount.description_en: (Optional) The number of text messages that were sent in a composite push but were not received
SmsReceiveFailedCount.description_zh: （可为空）短信复合推送发出但是手机未收到的短信数目

SmsReceiveSuccessCount.description_en: (Optional) The number of text messages successfully received in a composite push
SmsReceiveSuccessCount.description_zh: （可为空）短信复合推送成功收到的短信数目

SmsSentCount.description_en: (Optional) The number of text messages sent in a composite push
SmsSentCount.description_zh: （可为空）短信复合推送发出的短信数目

SmsSkipCount.description_en: (Optional) The number of text messages skipped in a composite push, for example, when no mobile number is bound
SmsSkipCount.description_zh: （可为空）短信复合推送跳过发送短信的数目，例如未绑手机号
